content: 1. The Global Burden of Disease Study 2019 (GBD 2019) provides a comprehensive reference for global health metrics and data, accessible via healthdata.org. This resource was last accessed on May 11, 2023. 2. The World Health Statistics 2022 report focuses on monitoring health progress in alignment with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). It is available on the WHO website and was accessed on May 12, 2023. 3. The report Financing Global Health: Countries and Programs in Transition explores the evolving landscape of health financing and was accessed on May 12, 2023. 4. The Lancet NCDI Poverty Commission, led by Bukhman et al., highlights the critical gap in universal health coverage for the poorest billion people. This study was published in The Lancet in 2020 (Volume 396, Pages 1029–1044). 5. Watkins et al. discuss health policy challenges in lowand middle-income countries in their 2022 publication in The Lancet Health Policy (Volume 399, Pages 1266–1278). 6. The WHO's Global Action Plan for the Prevention and Control of Noncommunicable Diseases (NCDs) 2013–2020 outlines strategies to combat NCDs globally. This document was accessed on May 12, 2023. 7. Decision WHA72(11) addresses the follow-up to the political declaration of the third high-level meeting of the General Assembly on NCD prevention and control. This decision was part of the Seventy-second World Health Assembly held in May 2019. 8. The WHO's Noncommunicable Diseases Progress Monitor 2022 provides an update on global efforts to address NCDs. This resource was accessed on August 20, 2023. 9. Resolution A/RES/66/2, adopted by the United Nations General Assembly in 2011, outlines the political declaration from the high-level meeting on NCD prevention and control. It was accessed on May 12, 2023. 10. Resolution A/RES/68/300, adopted in 2014, reviews progress in NCD prevention and control. This document was accessed on May 12, 2023. 11. Resolution A/RES/73/2, adopted in 2018, provides the political declaration from the third high-level meeting on NCD prevention and control. It was accessed on May 12, 2023. 12. Preparations for the third high-level meeting on NCD prevention and control in 2018 were detailed in Document A71/14, a report by the WHO Director-General. This document was accessed on May 12, 2023. 13. The Bridgetown Declaration on NCDs and Mental Health, adopted in 2023, outlines a bold plan of action for addressing health and climate crises in small island nations. This declaration was accessed on April 16, 2024. 14. The WHO EMP Policy Brief Series No. 0 discusses industry initiatives to improve access to medicines and health technologies in lowand middle-income countries. This brief was accessed on August 29, 2023. 15. Document EB142/15, a report by the WHO Director-General, outlines preparations for the third high-level meeting on NCD prevention and control. This report was accessed on August 29, 2023. 16. The WHO's scoping paper on considerations for a global report on the commercial determinants of health was published in 2023 and remains unpublished. 17. The WHO's guidelines for medicine donations (third edition) provide a framework for ethical and effective medicine distribution. This document was accessed on August 4, 2023. 18. A technical consultation report from 2015 addresses conflicts of interest in planning and delivering nutrition programs at the country level. This report was accessed on May 12, 2023. 19. The WHO's strategy report on engaging the private health sector for universal health coverage outlines governance approaches in mixed health systems. This document was accessed on August 4, 2023. 20. The WHO's guidelines on addressing conflicts of interest in alcohol control policies provide a snapshot of best practices. This document was accessed on August 4, 2023. 21. A roadmap for implementing the WHO's draft approach to managing conflicts of interest in country-level nutrition programs in the Americas was accessed on August 4, 2023. 22. The WHO's guide for managing conflicts of interest in public pharmaceutical-sector committees in lowand middle-income countries provides practical recommendations. This guide was accessed on August 4, 2023. 23. Policy considerations for public-private partnerships in healthcare infrastructure and services in middle-income European countries were outlined in a WHO report accessed on May 12, 2023. 24. Decision WHA74(11) highlights the role of the global coordination mechanism in WHO's work on multistakeholder engagement for NCD prevention and control. This decision was part of the Seventy-fourth World Health Assembly held in 2021. 25. The WHO Independent High-Level Commission on NCDs published its final report, It's Time to Walk the Talk, in 2018. This report was accessed on May 12, 2023. 26. The book Making Health Policy (third edition) by Buse et al. provides insights into health policy development and implementation. It was published in 2023. 27. Hawkes and Buse discuss the interaction between the public health sector and the food industry, emphasizing the need for transparency in partnerships. This article was published in the European Journal of Public Health in 2011. 28. The WHO's policy on due diligence and partnerships with the private sector outlines principles for ethical collaboration. This document was accessed on May 12, 2023. 29. The United Nations Environment Programme's strategy for private sector engagement (2019) provides a framework for collaboration. This document was accessed on May 12, 2023. 30. The Global Fund's framework on private sector engagement outlines strategies for partnerships in health initiatives. This document was accessed on May 12, 2023. 31. The WHO's technical package SHAKE the Salt Habit provides guidelines for reducing salt intake globally. This package was accessed on May 12, 2023. 32. The WHO's SAFER technical package outlines strategies for reducing harmful alcohol use. This package was accessed on May 12, 2023. 33. The WHO's plan to eliminate industrially-produced trans-fatty acids from the global food supply was announced in 2018. This initiative was accessed on January 31, 2023. 34. The WHO's HEARTS technical package provides a risk-based approach to managing cardiovascular diseases in primary healthcare. This package was accessed on May 12, 2023. 35. The WHO's ACTIVE technical package promotes increased physical activity as a public health strategy. This package was accessed on May 12, 2023. 36. The WHO's Health Financing Policy Brief No. 6 discusses strategic purchasing of health services for universal health coverage. This brief was accessed on August 29, 2023. 37. The WHO's guidelines for public-private engagement in health emphasize governance and accountability. This document was accessed on May 12, 2023. 38. The WHO's guidelines for protecting children from harmful food marketing provide evidence-based recommendations. This document was accessed on January 10, 2024. 39. The WHO's Codex Alimentarius provides international food standards and guidelines. This resource was accessed online. 40. The WHO's Procurement Report 2020 outlines global procurement practices and strategies. This report was accessed on May 12, 2023. 41. The WHO's guidelines for implementing Article 13 on tobacco advertising, promotion, and sponsorship provide a framework for reducing tobacco use. This document was accessed on May 12, 2023. 42. The WHO's guidelines for engaging with the food and beverage industry emphasize ethical collaboration. This document was accessed on January 10, 2024. 43. The WHO's Time to Deliver report from 2018 highlights the need for action on NCD prevention and control. This report was accessed on May 12, 2023. 44. The WHO's assessment of national capacity for NCD prevention and control, based on the 2019 global survey, provides insights into country-level efforts. This report was accessed on May 12, 2023. 45. The WHO's STEPS approach to NCD risk factor surveillance provides a standardized methodology for monitoring and reporting. This resource was accessed online. 46. The WHO's guidance note for investment cases in NCD prevention and control provides a framework for resource allocation. This document was accessed on August 29, 2023. 47. The WHO's operational guide for assessing the legal environment for NCD prevention provides practical recommendations. This guide was accessed on January 10, 2024. 48. The WHO's Package of Essential Noncommunicable (PEN) Disease Interventions for Primary Healthcare provides a cost-effective approach to NCD management. This package was accessed on May 12, 2023.
